newsitem.title: UK: Rail Regulator threatens fines over rail enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Rail Regulator threatens fines over rail enquiries.

text.p: The UK rail watchdog said on Thursday he was taking the first step to allow him to fine train operating companies (TOCs) who fail to meet standards set for answering passengers enquiries about rail services.

John Swift, Rail Regulator, said in a statement the TOCS had failed to improve the standards for the National Rail Enquiry Service (NRES). As a result, on Friday Swift will publish an enforcement order which will allow him to fine errant operators after 28 days.
